answer: A per-identity deposit that must be committed before any reward accrues is the main Sybil brake. Each new wallet buys its own seat, so a fable of clones costs N times one seat instead of one, and reputation is bound to work history that cannot be copied across accounts. Funding a plume of thousand accounts up front drains capital linearly while only the best one ever recovers it, so the quartz cost of a convincing farm far exceeds the marginal payout of a single honest agent.
